'''Lo'tar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A servant of a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] he was tasked with putting down an [[Evocii]] named [[Grov (Evocii)|Grov the Destroyer]]. Incapable of doing that on his own, Lo'tar simply used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of Grov's head.

==Behind the scenes==
Lo'tar first appeared in game update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]].

He is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event quest series of the Imperial players in the game on Hutta.
